# VelocityAI

> VelocityAI is an intelligent, AI-powered study assistant platform designed to transform textbooks, lecture notes, academic PDFs, presentations, and audio recordings into concise, structured study summaries and interactive practice quizzes.

## Core Services

- [Dashboard](https://velocityaisoftware.app/dashboard): Main study overview, daily streaks, and document upload management.
- [AI Summarizer](https://velocityaisoftware.app/): Instant conversion of study materials into structured key points, conceptual breakdowns, and review sheets.
- [Practice Quizzes](https://velocityaisoftware.app/quizzes): AI-generated multiple-choice and conceptual practice questions with instant grading.
- [Adaptive Exam Planner](https://velocityaisoftware.app/planner): Study schedule calendar with weakness tracker and revision prioritization.
- [Study Notes Library](https://velocityaisoftware.app/notes): Personal collection of saved study guides, summaries, and generated materials.
